verses.ar: لِمَاذَا ٱرْتَجَّتِ ٱلْأُمَمُ، وَتَفَكَّرَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ فِي ٱلْبَاطِلِ؟
verses.kjv: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.web: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

verses.ar: قَامَ مُلُوكُ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَتَآمَرَ ٱلرُّؤَسَاءُ مَعًا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ وَعَلَى مَسِيحِهِ، قَائِلِينَ:
verses.kjv: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, [saying],
verses.web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

verses.kjv: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.web: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

verses.ar: اَلسَّاكِنُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ يَضْحَكُ. ٱلرَّبُّ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.web: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ يَتَكَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِغَضَبِهِ، وَيَرْجُفُهُمْ بِغَيْظِهِ.
verses.kjv: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.web: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

verses.ar: «أَمَّا أَنَا فَقَدْ مَسَحْتُ مَلِكِي عَلَى صِهْيَوْنَ جَبَلِ قُدْسِي».
verses.kjv: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.web: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

verses.ar: إِنِّي أُخْبِرُ مِنْ جِهَةِ قَضَاءِ ٱلرَّبِّ: قَالَ لِي: «أَنْتَ ٱبْنِي، أَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَدْتُكَ.
verses.kjv: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou [art] my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.web: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

verses.ar: ٱسْأَلْنِي فَأُعْطِيَكَ ٱلْأُمَمَ مِيرَاثًا لَكَ، وَأَقَاصِيَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مُلْكًا لَكَ.
verses.kjv: Ask of me, and I shall give [thee] the heathen [for] thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth [for] thy possession.
verses.web: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

verses.ar: تُحَطِّمُهُمْ بِقَضِيبٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ. مِثْلَ إِنَاءِ خَزَّافٍ تُكَسِّرُهُمْ».
verses.kjv: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
verses.web: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

verses.ar: فَٱلْآنَ يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُلُوكُ تَعَقَّلُوا. تَأَدَّبُوا يَا قُضَاةَ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.web: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

verses.kjv: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.web: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.ar: قَبِّلُوا ٱلِٱبْنَ لِئَلَّا يَغْضَبَ فَتَبِيدُوا مِنَ ٱلطَّرِيقِ. لِأَنَّهُ عَنْ قَلِيلٍ يَتَّقِدُ غَضَبُهُ. طُوبَى لِجَمِيعِ ٱلْمُتَّكِلِينَ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish [from] the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed [are] all they that put their trust in him.
verses.web: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
